metadata.name: Mcp
metadata.description: Tools > MCP server overview. The typed API surface the agents use to inspect every JsonUI project. 33 tools in five groups: A (lookup), B (validation), C (generation), D (build + runtime), E (API model discovery — new in 2026-05). ~12-min read. Companion to /tools/agents — agents are the clients, MCP is the protocol.

uiVariables.name: tools
uiVariables.description: 33 MCP tools. Each entry names the tool, declares its group (A/B/C/D/E), and a one-line role. Group E (added 2026-05) holds the 3 API Model Discovery tools: list_api_specs, list_api_models, preview_api_model_sync.

uiVariables.name: nextReadLinks
uiVariables.description: Two closing cards: Agents (client of MCP) + CLI (caller behind jui build).

eventHandlers.name: onAppear

methods.name: onAppear
methods.description: Seed tools + nextReadLinks. tools carries 33 MCP tool entries grouped A/B/C/D/E by function (Lookup / Validation / Generation / Build+Runtime / API Model Discovery). Each row's nameKey / groupKey / roleKey is pre-resolved via StringManager with the tools_mcp_ prefix. nextReadLinks points to /tools/agents and /tools/cli.

notes: Second live entry under the Tools tab. Flipping TOOLS_ENTRIES row 2 (mcp) from 'upcoming' to 'live' in HomeViewModel finishes the task.

33 tools total (as of 2026-05). Group A = 8 (lookup, incl. get_data_source), Group B = 6 (validation), Group C = 7 (generation), Group D = 9 (build + runtime), Group E = 3 (API Model Discovery — new 2026-05). Per-tool prose lives on /reference/mcp-tools; this page is the overview.
The cell uses a generic mcp_tool_row layout, not the agent_row layout — even though the visual is similar, the group pill differs in semantics (A/B/C/D/E letter code rather than a named role).

2026-05 update (swagger-driven Data Models): Group E added with 3 tools — list_api_specs (enumerate docs/api/), list_api_models (per-platform DTO/Domain/orphan inventory), preview_api_model_sync (dry-run filter changes; returns kept_schemas / filtered_out / skip_domain_matches / halts JSON). Body copy gains a Group E section after the existing D section; the section_groups_body / section_catalog_body / section_what_body strings are revised accordingly. Per /docs/plans/2026-05-27-swagger-models-doc-additions §5, this is also the trigger to fix the stale 'Rendered from live Swagger / tool manifests' phrasing in tools_mcp_section_catalog_body — replacement copy framing is 'Hand-authored catalog kept in sync with the MCP server's 5-group tool list (33 tools currently — A:8 / B:6 / C:7 / D:9 / E:3).' Detail page for each Group E tool is /reference/mcp-tools and /guides/api-data-models §5–§6.
